one_liner: Bobby Witt Jr. put 899 balls in play in 2025, second only to Jose Ramirez in this group -- volume and pop together.
three_things: Hard contact across the board: 85.8 mph average exit velocity, 105.9 mph at the 90th percentile.
Four-seam fastballs were 32.6% of the 2,469 pitches he saw -- the most fastball-heavy diet here after Mike Trout.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Contact numbers are over the 899 batted balls only, not all 2,469 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model that ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull, so no whiff rate or barrel profile. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Second only to Ramirez' and 'after Trout' are scoped to these twelve hitters.
